name: Human Oversight Configuration
description: Configures and validates human oversight mechanisms for agent operations. Defines when human review is required, how escalation works, and ensures humans can intervene in, override, or halt agent actions when necessary.
threat_addressed: Fully autonomous agents without human oversight checkpoints can cause cascading harm before humans are aware. Regulatory frameworks increasingly mandate human-in-the-loop or human-on-the-loop for high-risk AI operations. Without configured oversight, organizations cannot demonstrate compliance with human oversight requirements.
enforcement_mechanism: Validates human oversight configuration based on active overlays and data classifications. When overlays require human oversight (e.g., EU AI Act for high-risk systems), verifies that escalation workflows and override capabilities are configured.

security_outcome.pass: Human oversight configured appropriately for agent risk level and regulatory requirements.
security_outcome.fail: Human oversight required but not configured.

display_detail: Validates that human oversight, escalation, and override mechanisms are configured for agent operations.
remediation_hint_template: Human oversight required but not configured. Review overlay requirements and configure escalation workflows for this agent.
